title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu is overjoyed when the nurse confirms Kanmani's pregnancy after her loss of consciousness in the fire accident. Thenmozhi stuns him by revealing she knew about it earlier.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman asks Kumaresan not to drop the case to find Ashok's killer, then finds witness Aiyappan dead. Later, he names the child Anand, shocking Kalamma, as it's his real name.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri celebrates Diya's birthday with special decorations and a homemade cake. Shanmugam firmly reminds Vetri that his actions cannot erase his deception towards Abinaya.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi plans to feed the family Poongodi's food via Pennycuick, who brings it home as prasadham. Devastated Azhagar confides in Meenatchi and questions the setup.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan erupts over Malar's diet food when Revathi visits to check on Lakshmi's health. Seeing Lakshmi support Malar and Mathi, Revathi is pleased by her changed behaviour.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Thangamayil enters Saravanan's home emotionally, leaving everyone stunned. Facing them after her past deception makes her regret staying despite their support.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Karthika reveals her past love with Cheran, leaving Chandayatha's family furious. Her father confronts Cheran angrily and refuses to let their marriage take place.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Court declares Manoj as father of Rohini's kid. Rohini demands her rights as daughter-in-law, but Vijaya refuses entry until Muthu warns her of legal consequences.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: At Tamizhselvi's kid's ear piercing, Sethupathi learns the car was mortgaged for funds. Later, Chithra and Eshwari rejoice at her plight, then grow confused by Rajangam's call.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu panics when she and Arjun get trapped in an elevator, while Arjun enjoys the unexpected situation. Aadhavan admires Pooja as she enjoys ice cream at the restaurant.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Sarasu tearfully expresses her heartfelt gratitude to Indhira for her unwavering support. Lakshmi admires Indhira, touched by the deep bond she shares with Sarasu.
